experiment: MVP-7a KWX chunk worker first pass

environment.sourceTree: same dirty workspace snapshot for all four runs

derived.observedScaling: KWG time improved through eight workers; end-to-end wall time saturated at four workers.

semanticParity.coChanges: same row count; recency is time-dependent and was not used as an exact-value gate
semanticParity.defUseChains: row counts varied across separate runs (18,322 / 18,370 / 18,344 / 18,280); full-index parity is not established

limitations: Single run per worker count, no warm-up, no peak RSS, and no queue/worker-startup instrumentation; results are directional only.
KWX worker pool parallelizes chunks within each file; the outer document and source-comment loops remain serial.
The current worker-count thresholds require repeated runs on the same host before selecting a default or claiming stable scaling.
Exact KWX-relevant output rows match, but ancillary def-use rows varied; investigate that baseline variance before a full-database parity claim.
The SQLite sink was not instrumented in this experiment.
